summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus private helpers, stdlib only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Lines in all three Python files are within 120 columns, and short statements and literals were collapsed to one line. Tests and black were not run, per instructions, so the results are unverified. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the key raises ValueError, a non-object top-level JSON raises the missing-key ValueError, items are shallow-copied before path resolution, and isfile is used for the existence check.
